title_en: Paw Patrol: Hot Air Balloon Race
full_text_zh:
[P1] nickelodeon
PAW
PATROL
汪汪队立大功儿童安全救援故事书
热气球比赛
美国尼克儿童频道／著
安东尼／译
天地出版社｜TIANDI PRESS

[P2] 今天是一年一度的“市长杯”热气球比赛，冒险湾的古威市长有点儿紧张。
“我真后悔来参加比赛。”她抱怨道，“看来，我必须克服自己的恐高症了！"
莱德安慰她说：“别担心！我会在热气球上帮助您的！把热气球铺展开吧，狗狗们！"
“收到！”小砾答道。

[P3] 小砾和阿奇正在展开满是灰尘的热气球。
“哦，天哪！这也太……阿嚏！”阿奇边干边打喷嚏。
当止住喷嚏准备继续工作时，他突然大喊道：“糟了，
热气球上有个洞，这可怎么办？”
古威市长很沮丧：“这下云雾谷
的哈丁格市长又要胜出了。”
“别担心！”莱德说，“我们会让
您顺利参加比赛的。没有困难的工作，
只有勇敢的狗狗！”
莱德随即取出平板电脑，通知其
余汪汪队成员马上集合。

[P4] 狗狗们迅速在塔台集合完毕。“报告莱德队长，可以开始行动了！”阿奇大声说。

莱德向狗狗们说明了关于古威市长和热气球的情况：“为了比赛我们要尽快修好气球。灰灰，能在你的回收卡车里找到修补气球的东西吗？”

“旧物别丢掉，还有大用处！”灰灰答道。

“热气球需要热力燃烧装置加热空气升空，”莱德继续说道，“毛毛，我需要你确保燃烧设备的安全。”

“火力全开！”毛毛叫道。

[P5] 狗狗们迅速来到市政广场。灰灰快速检查了一下热气球的破洞，说：“我的卡车里恰好有合适的补丁！”
“燃气罐那边情况怎么样了？”莱德问。
“得确保燃气不会泄漏。”毛毛回答。他用鼻子使劲嗅了嗅说：“嗯，没有闻到燃气的味道。”

灰灰从路马的旧拖伞上剪下一块胶皮，把它粘到热气球的破洞上。
“干得漂亮！”莱德说，“这块补丁正合适！”
莱德放下控制杆，热气缓缓注入热气球内。其他的参赛热气球也集结到了出发点，比赛马上开始！

[P6] “是时候克服我的恐高症了！”市长大喊，“我要赢得比赛！”
她使劲挥起拳头给自己加油，却碰到了热控杆，热气翻滚起来，
热气球立刻腾空而起。
毛毛赶紧冲过来，想跳起来咬住缆绳使热气球停下来，但它还是飞了起来，把毛毛也拽上了天空。热气球越飞越高。
突然，绳子从毛毛嘴里滑落，眼看他就要掉到地上了。

[P7] 还好莱德接住了毛毛。
“谢谢你，莱德！”毛毛说道。
比赛开始了，现在已经没有时间了，莱德只能通过平板电脑呼叫天天。
“古威市长的热气球在没有载上我的情况下就升空了！我需要你用直升机把我送上去。”
天天收到消息后赶紧跑出狗狗之家，冲进了直升机。
“狗狗要飞上天啦！”她兴奋地叫道。

[P8] 天天给莱德扔下了一个安全带，等他扣紧后，拉着他飞上了天空。
“我一定会把你送到热气球上的。”她说。但是他们必须得加快速度了，因为古威市长的热气球已经接近海豹岛的灯塔了。
很快，莱德就到达了热气球的载人篮筐边。

[P9] 古威市长帮助莱德爬上了热气球。他迅速加大火力，操控热气球及时避开了灯塔。
“没事了，天天。”莱德一边说，一边解开了安全带。
“加油！一定要赢！”天天的声音逐渐远去。

“现在没问题了！古威市长，您准备好赢得比赛了吗？”
市长信心十足地说：“我们一定会赢！”
说完，他们立刻加快速度全力追赶前面的热气球。

[P10] 在莱德的操控下，热气球很快就追上了哈丁格市长。
“全速前进！”莱德喊道。
“你们别高兴得太早，我从来没有输过，况且我还没有开始发力呢！”哈丁格市长不服气地说。
在热力急速的作用下，莱德和古威市长的热气球呼啸而过，瞬间超越了哈丁格市长。
“快看，前面是一座高山！终点就在山的那一边！”古威市长喊道。

[P11] “风越来越大了！这对我们赢得比赛非常有利！”莱德说。
“再高一点，再快一点！”古威市长激动地说。
莱德操控着热气球顺着风
向加速攀升，他准备翻越前面的高山，不过哈丁格市长的热气球也在盘旋加速，并
逐渐超越了莱德他们。

[P12] 当热气球出现在人们的视线里时，在终点线上等候的狗狗们都大声欢呼起来。哈丁格市长的热气球颠簸着最先出现在空中，但是莱德和古威市长的热气球降落速度更快，他们领先哈丁格市长冲过了终点线，赢得了最终的胜利！

[P13] 哈丁格市长沮丧地把奖杯转交到古威市长手中。
古威市长又把奖杯递给了莱德，她大声宣布：“胜利属于莱德和狗狗们！”
“谢谢您，市长！”莱德微笑着说，“有困难就找汪汪队！”
full_text_en:
[P1] nickelodeon
PAW
PATROL
Paw Patrol: Children's Safety Rescue Storybook
Hot Air Balloon Race
By Nickelodeon Children's Channel
Translated by Anthony
Tiandi Press | TIANDI PRESS

[P2] Today is the annual 'Mayor's Cup' hot air balloon race, and Mayor Goodway of Adventure Bay is a bit nervous.
"I really regret signing up for this race," she complained. "Looks like I must overcome my fear of heights!"
Ryder reassured her: "Don't worry! I'll help you from the hot air balloon! Spread out the balloon, pups!"
"Roger that!" Rubble replied.

[P3] Rubble and Chase are unfolding a dusty hot air balloon.
“Oh, my! This is too… Achoo!” Chase sneezes while working.
When he stops sneezing and prepares to continue, he suddenly shouts, “Oh no, there’s a hole in the hot air balloon! What should we do?”
Mayor Goodway is very upset: “Now Mayor Harding from Cloudy Valley will win again.”
“Don’t worry!” Ryder says, “We’ll make sure you can join the competition. There’s no difficult job, only brave pups!”
Ryder immediately takes out his tablet and notifies the rest of the Paw Patrol team to gather right away.

[P4] The pups quickly gathered at the tower. "Report to Leader Ryder, we can begin the mission!" Chase shouted.

Ryder explained to the pups about Mayor Goodway and the hot air balloon: "To win the race, we need to fix the balloon quickly. Rocky, can you find something in your recycling truck to patch the balloon?"

"Don't throw away old things—they're still useful!" Rocky replied.

"Hot air balloons need a burner to heat the air and rise," Ryder continued, "Mighty, I need you to make sure the burner equipment is safe."

"Full power!" Mighty called out.

[P5] The pups quickly arrived at the city square. Rocky quickly checked the hole in the hot air balloon and said, "I happen to have the perfect patch in my truck!"
"How's the gas tank situation?" Ryder asked.
"We need to make sure there's no gas leak," Marshall replied. He sniffed hard with his nose and said, "Hmm, I don't smell any gas."

Rocky cut a piece of rubber from Lou's old parasail and stuck it onto the hole in the hot air balloon.
"Well done!" Ryder said. "That patch fits perfectly!"
Ryder released the control lever, and hot air was slowly pumped into the balloon. The other competing hot air balloons had also gathered at the starting point—the race was about to begin!

[P6] "It's time to overcome my fear of heights!" the mayor shouted, "I'm going to win the race!"
She punched the air to cheer herself on, but accidentally hit the control lever. The hot air began to swirl, and the hot air balloon shot up into the sky.
Mao Mao rushed over, trying to jump up and bite the rope to stop the balloon, but it kept rising, pulling Mao Mao up into the sky too. The balloon flew higher and higher.
Suddenly, the rope slipped from Mao Mao's mouth, and he was about to fall to the ground.

[P7] Luckily, Ryder caught Marshall.
"Thank you, Ryder!" Marshall said.
The race has started, and there's no time left. Ryder can only call Skye through his tablet.
"Mayor Goodway's hot air balloon took off without me! I need you to take me up in the helicopter!"
Skye received the message and quickly ran out of the Pup House, rushing into the helicopter.
"Pups are flying to the sky!" she exclaimed excitedly.

[P8] Skye threw a safety harness down to Ryder. After he fastened it, she pulled him up into the sky.
"I'll definitely get you to the hot air balloon," she said. But they had to speed up, because Mayor Goodway's hot air balloon was already approaching the lighthouse on Seal Island.
Soon, Ryder reached the basket of the hot air balloon.

[P9] Mayor Goodway helped Ryder climb onto the hot air balloon. He quickly increased the heat and steered the balloon away from the lighthouse.
"It's okay, Skye," Ryder said, as he unbuckled his safety belt.
"Come on! You've got to win!" Skye's voice faded into the distance.

"Now it's all good! Mayor Goodway, are you ready to win the race?"
The mayor said confidently, "We're going to win!"
Then, they immediately sped up to catch up with the hot air balloons ahead.

[P10] Under Ryder's control, the hot air balloon quickly caught up with Mayor Hardinger.
"Full speed ahead!" Ryder shouted.
"Don't get too excited, I've never lost before, and I haven't even started to give it my all yet!" Mayor Hardinger said不服气地.
Under the rapid thrust of heat, Ryder's and Mayor Goodway's hot air balloon roared past, instantly overtaking Mayor Hardinger.
"Look, there's a mountain ahead! The finish line is on the other side of the mountain!" Mayor Goodway shouted.

[P11] "The wind is getting stronger! This is very advantageous for us to win the race!" said Ryder.
"Higher, faster!" Mayor Goodway said excitedly.
Ryder was maneuvering the hot air balloon, accelerating with the wind, preparing to cross the mountain ahead. However, Mayor Hardinger's hot air balloon was also circling and accelerating, gradually overtaking Ryder and his team.

[P12] When the hot air balloons appeared in people's sight, the puppies waiting at the finish line cheered loudly. Mayor Hardinger's hot air balloon appeared first in the sky, bumpy and shaky, but Ryder and Mayor Goodway's hot air balloon descended faster. They took the lead over Mayor Hardinger, crossed the finish line first, and won the final victory!

[P13] Mayor Hardinger sadly handed the trophy over to Mayor Goodway.
Mayor Goodway then passed the trophy to Ryder, announcing loudly, "The victory belongs to Ryder and the pups!"
"Thank you, Mayor!" Ryder smiled, saying, "When in trouble, call the PAW Patrol!"
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《汪汪队立大功儿童安全救援故事书》中《热气球比赛》一册的封面，展示了主角狗狗马歇尔正在用绳索救援热气球上的孩子，背景为蓝天绿地，画面充满动感与救援主题。
[P2] 本页描绘了冒险湾市长古威因恐高而对参加热气球比赛感到紧张，莱德安慰她并指挥狗狗们准备热气球，小砾回应收到指令，画面展现了比赛前的准备场景。
[P3] 小砾和阿奇在准备热气球时发现气球有洞，古威市长因担心输掉比赛而沮丧，莱德安慰她并立即通知其他汪汪队成员集合。
[P4] 汪汪队成员在塔台集合完毕，莱德指挥大家分工合作修理热气球，灰灰负责寻找修补材料，毛毛负责检查燃烧设备安全，阿奇报告准备就绪。
[P5] 汪汪队成员在市政广场紧急修理热气球，灰灰用胶皮补好破洞，毛毛确认燃气安全，莱德指挥注入热气，所有参赛热气球集结完毕，比赛即将开始。
[P6] 市长决心克服恐高症参加热气球比赛，因激动误触控制杆导致热气球突然升空，毛毛试图用绳索阻止但被一同带起，绳子滑脱后毛毛即将坠落。
[P7] 毛毛被莱德接住后，莱德通过平板电脑呼叫天天，请求她用直升机将自己送往升空的热气球；天天收到消息后兴奋地驾驶直升机出发。
[P8] 天天用直升机将莱德送往升空的热气球，莱德在安全带的保护下被吊起，很快到达了热气球的载人篮筐边。
[P9] 莱德在古威市长的帮助下登上热气球，成功避开灯塔并解开安全带，天天驾驶直升机离开。莱德与市长确认准备就绪后，全力追赶前方的热气球参赛者。
[P10] 莱德操控热气球追上并超越了哈丁格市长，古威市长则兴奋地指出前方的高山和终点位置。
[P11] 莱德和古威市长乘坐热气球在风中加速攀升，准备翻越高山，但哈丁格市长的热气球正在加速并逐渐超越他们。
[P12] 莱德和古威市长驾驶的热气球率先冲过终点线，赢得比赛胜利，终点线的狗狗们欢呼庆祝。
[P13] 哈丁格市长将奖杯交给古威市长，古威市长再将奖杯授予莱德，并宣布胜利属于莱德和狗狗们，莱德感谢市长并重申汪汪队的口号。
